description: This file defines the 'Review' model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for adding reviews, retrieving reviews by product ID with pagination, and counting total reviews for a specific product. The class interacts directly with the database to perform CRUD operations related to product reviews.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Model class for handling product reviews, including adding reviews, fetching reviews, and counting review records.

methods.name: addReview
methods.description: Inserts a new review record into the database for a given product, with review details provided in the data array.

methods.name: getReviewsByProductId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reviews for a specific product with pagination support, filtering by product status and language.

methods.name: getTotalReviewsByProductId
methods.description: Counts the total number of approved reviews for a particular product.
